summary: The brand-domain CSP finding was taken to ground. The zone injects an INLINE __CF$cv$params script, so no script-src origin can permit it and the per-request params admit no static hash; a controlled probe serving this repo index.html under the proposed header still refused it. Option A is therefore inert and no _headers change was made. The finding is recorded as blocked-and-accepted by design. Two record corrections followed, one of which fixed a note that was simply false. The ratchet drops fall 4 -> 2, and both remaining ones are the baseline being wrong rather than a regression. NOT MERGED: the scoped gate exits 1 at 97.75/99, and correctness cannot reach proven while this record truthfully says the PR is open.

summary: Owner ruling on the deadlock: the all-proven exit rule now gates a SCOPED run from P0.4, not only the whole-program P10 bar. P0.3 is exempt because the rule cannot judge its own author - the record must truthfully say the PR is open and its gate failing, which holds correctness below proven until it merges, and it cannot merge until the gate passes. The exemption is coarse because the plan lists P0.3 as one item with no P0.3d id, so a scoped run cannot be named finely enough to exempt only P0.3(c); a test fails if the plan ever grows sub-ids. This is a STRICTER scoped gate than before, not a looser one: scoped mode previously reported facets short of proven without enforcing them. P0.3(c) lands on 5/5 CI green with the scoped Jev report as the plan 9 rule 6 owner-run substitute, reading 97.75/99 with correctness and security short of proven.
